---
name: Bug report
about: Reproduce a problem without sharing private artifacts
---

## Expected and observed behavior

## Minimal reproduction

Include commands, Bun/Node/OS versions and commit. For a provider issue, include CLI version and whether a scripted fixture also reproduces it. Share a small redacted example, never credentials, real chat logs or unreviewed screenshots.

## Evidence

Relevant failing check, redacted error, or fictional screenshot. Explain whether the problem survives a clean restart.
